91043.overview: In 007 James Bond you control James Bond in his multi purpose craft. This craft can travel on both land and sea, can jump over danger, or fire at enemies on the many different levels. Each horizontally scrolling level in the game is loosely based on a different James Bond movie. The levels included are Diamonds Are Forever, The Spy Who Loved Me, Moonraker, and For Your Eyes Only. Each level has a variety of enemies trying to destroy you, and a unique goal that must be accomplished to continue on. If you can complete all the missions, you win the game! Good luck, Mr. Bond.

418237.overview:
Paco and Puri Rebollez, siblings, are astronauts in charge of finding and gathering energonia crystals, a material used to power spaceships. To aid them in their hard job, they have special suits equiped with a small thermonuclear cell in the buttocks zone which exhales an invisible gas which Paco and Puri use to rise and fly around.

Paco and Puri‘s company has detected an old abandoned ship containing as much as 20 crystals. The siblings could retire if they could gather such a number of crystals, so they decides to ignore the perils they might find inside the ship and begin the search!
